parameters.subset_selection: first k documents in document-ID byte order, which is the order of the law

queries.role: series 02 query word, rare in BGB
series 02 query word, rare in BGB

parameters.schedule: subset builds ascending with measure_phase; then all (algorithm, query) blocks on the full corpus shuffled once per warmup/repetition with fixed seed (measure_comparison of series 02)

timer: time.perf_counter_ns; integer elapsed_ns per complete build or query block
background_load: Keine parallelen Messungen, Agenten oder Builds; Videopipeline pausiert; Lastmittel vor Start 1.22 2.47 4.43
cache: corpus loaded and prepared once before timing; prepared subsets and full index reused; no cold-cache claim

timing_boundaries.build: complete public build_inverted_index on already prepared first-k documents; check after timer
timing_boundaries.query: public search_direct_word or search_index_word on the full BGB; normalization and full fresh sorted result list included; query_block_size complete calls retained then checked
timing_boundaries.excluded: loading, preparation, independent tokenization, expectation checks, memory profiling, output

statistics: median, inclusive Q1/Q3, IQR=Q3-Q1; one block is one sample; quartiles are not confidence intervals

memory.retained_traced_bytes: tracemalloc current_after_build-current_before_build; tracer starts after preparation
memory.exclusive_index_bytes: sys.getsizeof unique index/proxy/dict/tuple/str objects, excluding corpus strings
memory.limitations: Python traced allocations and object graph estimates (memory.py of series 02), not RSS

interpretation_limits: Subsets are nested prefixes in the order of the law, not random samples; topic changes along the law.
Real paragraphs have very unequal lengths (8 to 1168 tokens).
Heaps fit over six nested subsets is descriptive, not a statistical model test.
Expected postings derive from an independent regex tokenization checked against manifest counts.
